<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=240,initial-scale=1">
<title>Golden character</title>
<style>
html,body,canvas{display:block;margin:0;width:240px;height:294px;overflow:hidden}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';

const scene=new THREE.Scene();
scene.background=new THREE.Color(0xf9f8f3);
const renderer=new THREE.WebGLRenderer({preserveDrawingBuffer:true});
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
renderer.setSize(240,294);
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);
const ref=new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-120,120,147,-147,.1,1500);
ref.position.set(0,147,600);
ref.lookAt(0,147,0);

function group(parent,name){
  const g=new THREE.Group();
  g.name=name;
  parent.add(g);
  return g;
}
const figure=group(scene,'golden-pear-character');
const trunk=group(figure,'torso');
const head=group(figure,'head');
const eyes=group(head,'eyes');
const mouth=group(head,'mouth');
const vec=(x,y,z)=>new THREE.Vector3(x,y,z);
const sphere=new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,32,24);
function oval(parent,name,x,y,z,w,h,d,color){
  const m=new THREE.Mesh(sphere,new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color,roughness:.85}));
  m.name=name;
  m.position.set(x,y,z);
  m.scale.set(w,h,d);
  parent.add(m);
  return m;
}

// The horizontal rings follow the crown, shoulders, belly and hips of the first pose.
function skin(parent,name,rows){
  const cols=[1,2,3,4].map(k=>new THREE.SplineCurve(rows.map((r,i)=>new THREE.Vector2(i,r[k]))));
  const pos=[],colors=[],indices=[];
  const sides=64,steps=(rows.length-1)*5;
  for(let j=0;j<=steps;j++){
    const u=j/steps,v=u*(rows.length-1),a=Math.min(rows.length-2,Math.floor(v)),t=v-a;
    const y=-THREE.MathUtils.lerp(rows[a][0],rows[a+1][0],t);
    const [x,z,w,d]=cols.map(c=>c.getPoint(u).y);
    const color=new THREE.Color(rows[a][5]).lerp(new THREE.Color(rows[a+1][5]),t);
    for(let i=0;i<=sides;i++){
      const ang=i/sides*2*Math.PI;
      pos.push(x+Math.max(.015,w)*Math.sin(ang),y,z+Math.max(.015,d)*Math.cos(ang));
      const shade=1+.016*Math.sin(3*ang-.03*y);
      colors.push(color.r*shade,color.g*shade,color.b*shade);
      if(i<sides && j<steps){
        const b=j*(sides+1)+i;
        indices.push(b,b+sides+1,b+1,b+1,b+sides+1,b+sides+2);
      }
    }
  }
  const geo=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geo.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos,3));
  geo.setAttribute('color',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(colors,3));
  geo.setIndex(indices);
  geo.computeVertexNormals();
  const m=new THREE.Mesh(geo,new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({vertexColors:true,roughness:.91}));
  m.name=name;
  parent.add(m);
}
skin(trunk,'continuous pear-shaped body',[
 [19,1,-2,.1,.1,0xe8b337],[27,1,-2,20,17,0xe9aa26],
 [37,-1,-2,27,23,0xedad27],[52,-3,-2,34,28,0xf4b527],
 [70,-4,-1,40,33,0xffc531],[87,-4,1,44,36,0xffcd56],
 [105,-4,3,50,41,0xffdb93],[123,-3,4,55,45,0xfad288],
 [144,-1,4,57,47,0xedad58],[163,0,2,57,45,0xf1b138],
 [178,0,0,53,40,0xecaa26],[193,-1,-1,45,33,0xe5a025],
 [206,-2,-1,36,25,0xd99725],[214,-3,-1,22,16,0xcd9025],
 [218,-3,-1,.1,.1,0xc98c23]
]);
skin(head,'rounded crown and cheeks',[
 [0,0,0,.1,.1,0xffcf48],[1.5,0,0,9,8,0xf9c643],[5,1,0,16,14,0xf6c330],
 [13,2,0,20,18,0xf5bd28],[23,1,1,22,20,0xefb52c],
 [32,0,1,23,22,0xe6a632],[42,-1,0,25,22,0xdd9c30],
 [52,-2,-2,22,19,0xe4a22e],[60,-2,-2,.1,.1,0xeaaa32]
]);
const pupils=[],lids=[];
for(const s of [-1,1]){
  const e=group(eyes,(s<0?'left':'right')+'-eye');
  e.position.set(1+s*13,-19,15);
  e.rotation.y=s*.43;
  lids.push(oval(e,'golden eyelid',0,0,0,5.5,4.5,3.1,0xdeab34));
  pupils.push(oval(e,'dark eye',0,0,2.3,3.75,4.45,2.2,0x10140c));
}
oval(head,'low broad muzzle',2,-28,21,12.5,4.8,4.5,0xe9af39);
const lipCurve=new THREE.QuadraticBezierCurve3(vec(-8,1,-1),vec(0,-3,2),vec(9,1,-1));
const lip=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TubeGeometry(lipCurve,18,.85,8,false),
 new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x685121}));
mouth.position.set(2,-31,25);
mouth.add(lip);

const legs=[],arms=[];
const down=vec(0,-1,0);
for(const s of [-1,1]){
  const label=s<0?'left':'right';
  const leg=group(figure,label+'-leg');
  leg.position.set(s*20-1,-179,-1);
  skin(leg,'tapered leg',[
    [-10,0,0,.1,.1,0xeaaa2b],[1,0,0,19,22,0xedac32],[18,0,0,21,22,0xe4a129],
    [37,0,0,18.3,19,0xdb9325],[58,-s*2,1,15.4,17,0xdb952a],
    [84,-s*4,2,13,15,0xdf982a],[108,-s*6,2,11.5,14,0xd89428],
    [117,-s*6,4,10,15,0xc98a23],[121,-s*6,5,.1,.1,0xc98a23]
  ]);
  legs.push(leg);
  const arm=group(figure,label+'-arm');
  const hand=group(arm,label+'-hand');
  oval(hand,'palm',0,-4,0,6.1,9,4.5,0x665335);
  for(let k=0;k<4;k++){
    const finger=oval(hand,'finger-'+k,(k-1.5)*3,-13-Math.sin(k*Math.PI/3)*2,1,
      1.65,6.7,1.85,0x504432);
    finger.rotation.z=(k-1.5)*.13;
  }
  oval(hand,'thumb',-s*6,-6,2.2,2.4,6.1,2.2,0x635135).rotation.z=-s*.48;
  const rings=30,sides=20;
  const geo=new THREE.BufferGeometry(),idx=[],colors=[];
  const pos=new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(new Float32Array((rings+1)*(sides+1)*3),3);
  for(let j=0;j<=rings;j++){
    const u=j/rings;
    const c=new THREE.Color(0xffc632).lerp(new THREE.Color(0xe4a538),u*.85)
      .lerp(new THREE.Color(0x826838),THREE.MathUtils.smoothstep(u,.87,1));
    for(let i=0;i<=sides;i++){
      colors.push(c.r,c.g,c.b);
      const n=j*(sides+1)+i;
      if(j<rings&&i<sides)idx.push(n,n+1,n+sides+1,n+1,n+sides+2,n+sides+1);
    }
  }
  geo.setIndex(idx);
  geo.setAttribute('position',pos);
  geo.setAttribute('color',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(colors,3));
  const mesh=new THREE.Mesh(geo,new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({vertexColors:true,side:THREE.DoubleSide,roughness:.9}));
  mesh.name='flexing arm';
  mesh.frustumCulled=false;
  arm.add(mesh);
  arms.push({s,hand,geo,pos,rings,sides});
}

const times=[0,800,1530,2330,3130,3930,4670,5470,5540];
// Screen position of the crown, body scale, turn, lean, eye opening and smile.
const poses=[
 [100,18,1,0,0,0,.35],[78,43,.97,.31,-.065,1,.9],
 [91,30,.99,.08,-.014,1,1],[114,-18,1.47,0,-.01,1,-.68],
 [90,12,1.16,.08,.038,1,.8],[103,21,1.05,-1.45,-.015,1,.5],
 [109,22,1.07,-1.48,.032,1,.55],[101,19,1.06,-1.55,.055,1,.4],
 [100,18,1,0,0,0,.35]
];
// Elbow, wrist and fingertip direction in the character's local frame.
const left=[
 [-51,-115,-4,-63,-174,2,-.34,-1,.1],
 [-40,-92,21,-12,-48,42,.65,.8,.12],
 [-44,-110,15,-41,-76,37,-.28,1,.38],
 [-49,-114,0,-63,-143,13,-1,-.4,.1],
 [-32,-102,19,-22,-82,55,.25,.54,1],
 [-33,-78,34,-30,-64,66,.1,.2,1],
 [-30,-83,38,-32,-65,66,.15,.23,1],
 [-36,-118,-7,-35,-168,-17,-.2,-1,-.4],
 [-51,-115,-4,-63,-174,2,-.34,-1,.1]
];
const right=[
 [50,-119,-4,60,-179,2,.3,-1,.15],
 [33,-75,26,20,-41,38,-.6,.71,.43],
 [58,-106,10,74,-98,18,1,-.38,.28],
 [49,-114,-1,53,-153,1,.05,-1,.22],
 [49,-111,-4,59,-167,2,.45,-1,.14],
 [32,-85,48,32,-42,56,.08,.94,-.35],
 [34,-92,46,35,-57,61,.12,.85,.45],
 [39,-123,-13,35,-180,-27,.12,-.8,-.55],
 [50,-119,-4,60,-179,2,.3,-1,.15]
];

function poseArm(arm,params){
  const {s,hand,pos,geo,rings,sides}=arm;
  const shoulder=vec(26*s,-52,-4), elbow=vec(...params.slice(0,3)), wrist=vec(...params.slice(3,6));
  const dir=vec(...params.slice(6)).normalize();
  hand.position.copy(wrist);
  hand.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(down,dir);
  const start=shoulder.clone().add(vec(-9*s,8,0));
  const upper=shoulder.clone().lerp(elbow,.34);
  upper.x+=s*3;
  const curve=new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3([start,shoulder,upper,elbow,wrist]);
  const frames=curve.computeFrenetFrames(rings,false);
  for(let j=0;j<=rings;j++){
    const u=j/rings,p=curve.getPointAt(u);
    const r=u<.19?THREE.MathUtils.lerp(3,12.4,Math.sin(u/.19*Math.PI/2)):
      THREE.MathUtils.lerp(12.4,4.6,THREE.MathUtils.smoothstep(u,.19,1));
    for(let i=0;i<=sides;i++){
      const a=i/sides*2*Math.PI;
      const q=p.clone().addScaledVector(frames.normals[j],Math.cos(a)*r)
        .addScaledVector(frames.binormals[j],Math.sin(a)*r);
      pos.setXYZ(j*(sides+1)+i,q.x,q.y,q.z);
    }
  }
  pos.needsUpdate=true;
  geo.computeVertexNormals();
  geo.computeBoundingSphere();
}

scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xfff8e4,0xe1bf9b,1.58));
function sun(x,y,z,color,power){
  const l=new THREE.DirectionalLight(color,power);
  l.position.set(x,y,z);
  scene.add(l);
}
sun(-100,210,130,0xfff7da,1.55);
sun(100,90,-100,0xffe5ab,1.02);
const bg=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(1600,1200),new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
 depthWrite:false,
 vertexShader:`varying vec2 p;
 void main(){p=(modelMatrix*vec4(position,1.)).xy;gl_Position=projectionMatrix*modelViewMatrix*vec4(position,1.);}`,
 fragmentShader:`varying vec2 p;
 float hash(vec2 a){return fract(sin(dot(a,vec2(127.1,311.7)))*43758.5453);}
 void main(){
 float h=p.y;
 vec3 c=mix(vec3(.70,.68,.61),vec3(.995,.99,.98),smoothstep(-3.,45.,h));
 c=mix(c,vec3(.88,.90,.99),exp(-pow((h-245.)/16.,2.))*.72);
 c=mix(c,vec3(.93,.92,.84),smoothstep(248.,297.,h)*.9);
 vec2 q=floor(gl_FragCoord.xy);
 c+=(vec3(hash(q),hash(q+37.),hash(q+91.))-.5)*(.028+.080*smoothstep(180.,285.,h)+.06*(1.-smoothstep(10.,44.,h)));
 gl_FragColor=vec4(c,1.);}`
}));
bg.name='studio backdrop';
bg.position.set(0,147,-360);
bg.renderOrder=-10;
scene.add(bg);

function render(t){
  const phase=((t%5540)+5540)%5540;
  let k=0;
  while(k<times.length-2&&phase>=times[k+1])k++;
  const f=(phase-times[k])/(times[k+1]-times[k]);
  const blend=f*f*(3-2*f);
  const sample=track=>track[k].map((v,i)=>THREE.MathUtils.lerp(v,track[k+1][i],blend));
  const [x,y,size,yaw,lean,open,smile]=sample(poses);
  figure.position.set(x-120,294-y,0);
  figure.rotation.order='ZXY';
  figure.rotation.set(0,yaw,lean,'ZXY');
  figure.scale.setScalar(size);
  mouth.scale.y=smile;
  for(let i=0;i<2;i++){
    pupils[i].scale.y=4.45*Math.max(.06,open);
    pupils[i].position.z=-1+3.3*open;
    lids[i].scale.y=4.2;
    legs[i].rotation.x=(i===0?1:-1)*Math.sin(2*Math.PI*phase/5540)*.13;
    poseArm(arms[i],sample(i===0?left:right));
  }
  renderer.render(scene,ref);
}
window.nwb={scene,renderer,cameras:{ref},characters:[figure],render,ready:true};
render(0);
</script>
</body>
</html>
